description: This file defines the ExternalEventRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repositories for managing ExternalEvent entities. It includes custom query methods for retrieving, deleting, and updating external events based on their status and date criteria.

classes.name: ExternalEventRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for ExternalEvent entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findByStatusOrderByBusinessDateAscIdAsc
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ExternalEventView objects with a specific status, ordered by business date and ID, with pagination support.

methods.name: deleteOlderEventsWithSentStatus
methods.description: Deletes external events with a specific status that occurred on or before a given date, marked with the SENT status.

methods.name: markEventsSent
methods.description: Updates the status of a list of events to SENT and sets their sent timestamp.

calls: delete from ExternalEvent e where e.status = :status and e.businessDate <= :dateForPurgeCriteria
UPDATE ExternalEvent e SET e.status = org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.event.external.repository.domain.ExternalEventStatus.SENT, e.sentAt = :sentAt WHERE e.id IN :ids
